# jamfplatform_pro_self_service_macos_settings (Data Source)

Read the current Self Service for macOS app settings (Settings > Self Service > macOS). Singleton — one record per tenant.

**Required Jamf privileges**

The Jamf Platform API integration used by the provider must be granted the following privileges:

| Jamf Pro privilege | Scoped name |
|---|---|
| Read Self Service | `read:pro:self-service` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the current Self Service for macOS app settings.
data "jamfplatform_pro_self_service_macos_settings" "current" {}

output "self_service_login_method" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_self_service_macos_settings.current.login_method
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `alert_user_approved_mdm` (Boolean) Whether users are notified that they must approve the organization's MDM profile.
- `authentication_type` (String) Login type used when asking users to log in: `Basic` (Directory Service account or Jamf Pro user account) or `Saml` (Single Sign-On).
- `bookmarks_display_name` (String) Name displayed for the Bookmarks section in Self Service.
- `default_home_category_id` (Number) ID of the category shown when the landing page is `BROWSE`. `-1` means All Items.
- `default_landing_page` (String) Content that displays when Self Service opens: `HOME`, `BROWSE`, `HISTORY`, or `NOTIFICATIONS`.
- `fido2_enabled` (Boolean) Whether FIDO2 authentication is enabled.
- `id` (String) Fixed singleton identifier. Always `singleton`.
- `install_automatically` (Boolean) Whether the Self Service app is installed automatically on computers.
- `install_location` (String) Path at which the Self Service app is installed.
- `keychain_credential_storage_enabled` (Boolean) Whether users may store their login credentials in Keychain Access.
- `login_method` (String) Self Service user login behavior: `NotRequired` (login disabled), `Anonymous` (login optional), or `Required`.
- `notifications_enabled` (Boolean) Whether Self Service notifications are displayed for items available to users.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
